title: Habitat Schoolhouse Preschool Workbook 1 — Part 2 (Letters C, D + Count to 5)
publisher: The Habitat Schoolhouse Inc / Gumboot Kid

newActivityTypes.description: Full blank box with prompt: 'Draw a picture of your family.' Open-ended creative drawing + personal connection. Opens the workbook before the letter content.
newActivityTypes.skill: fine motor, creative expression, personal identity
newActivityTypes.recipeNote: New pattern: personal prompt page at workbook start

newActivityTypes.description: Letter Cc themed: caterpillar bodies made of circles with dot-trace numbers (1-6, then 1-5, then 1-7). Three caterpillars of increasing length. Child traces numbers while counting. Watercolor caterpillar illustrations around the margins.
newActivityTypes.skill: number tracing, counting sequence, fine motor
newActivityTypes.recipeNote: Themed counting-trace hybrid — the caterpillar body segments = number line

newActivityTypes.description: Letter Cc themed: 'Cloud Count — Count the clouds. It may help to place items on the clouds as they count them.' Watercolor clouds scattered across the page + frog asking 'How many clouds are there?' with dot-trace answer box.
newActivityTypes.skill: counting objects, one-to-one correspondence, manipulative use
newActivityTypes.recipeNote: Variant of counting mat using nature objects (clouds) instead of themed containers

newActivityTypes.description: Letter Cc themed: 'Color Mix Up — Mix yellow and blue to make green.' Watercolor Venn diagram showing two overlapping color circles. Blank box below for the child to mix actual paint and see the result.
newActivityTypes.skill: color theory (science), fine motor, cause-and-effect observation
newActivityTypes.recipeNote: Hands-on science experiment page — the workbook IS the experiment surface

newActivityTypes.description: Letter Dd themed: 'Playdough Shapes — Create the following shapes out of playdough.' Three large outline shapes (wavy rectangle, circle, triangle) serving as playdough mats. Designed for lamination.
newActivityTypes.skill: fine motor, shape recognition, kinesthetic learning
newActivityTypes.recipeNote: Lamination-ready manipulation page — the page is a SURFACE, not a writing exercise

comparisonToWorkbook5.progression: Workbook 1 is more sensory/kinesthetic (paint, playdough, placing objects). Workbook 5 adds more cognitive demands (anatomy labels, upper/lowercase sorting, comprehension questions). The series gradually shifts from concrete/tactile to abstract/analytical.

gaps.name: playdough-mat
gaps.description: A page with large outline shapes or letters designed as a SURFACE for playdough. The child places playdough on the shapes to form them. Must be designed for lamination — thick lines, generous sizing. The page is a tool, not a writing exercise.

gaps.name: color-mixing-experiment-page
gaps.description: A hands-on science page: shows two watercolor circles overlapping (color theory Venn diagram) and provides a blank box for the child to mix actual paint and observe the result. The workbook IS the experiment surface.

notes: Fifth Aless drop. Same Habitat Schoolhouse series as the previous two drops. This is Workbook 1 (beginning of sequence) which shows how the series starts simpler and more sensory/kinesthetic before building to more cognitive tasks in later workbooks. Key new patterns: personal prompt page ('Draw your family'), color mixing experiment page, and playdough shape mats. The progression from WB1 to WB5 demonstrates a concrete-to-abstract developmental arc.
